title: Rosatom: We are negotiating with Iran to build small nuclear power plants
text:
Rosatom: We are negotiating with Iran to build small nuclear power plants"

"🔹The CEO of the state-owned Rosatom Corporation announced that the presidents of Russia and Iran discussed the situation of the Bushehr nuclear power plant in detail during their bilateral meeting in Bishkek."

"🔹According to RIA Novosti, citing Alexei Likhachev, CEO of the state-owned Rosatom Corporation, Russian specialists are still returning to the Bushehr nuclear power plant in Iran, and currently the total number of Russian employees present at the power plant is 45."

"🔺The CEO of the state-owned Rosatom corporation announced that Russia has presented Iran with a draft intergovernmental agreement for the construction of small nuclear power plants."

"🔺According to Likhachev, this issue was raised in recent talks between Russia and Iran, and Tehran is interested in developing nuclear power generation with smaller capacities. Rosatom has also announced its intention to participate in these projects."

"🔺He also said that Iran will develop its nuclear program after returning to normal and peaceful conditions, and Russia is ready to cooperate in this process."

"🔹It was previously reported that Iran and Russia signed an agreement worth $25 billion in late September 2025 to build four power units at the new Hormoz nuclear power plant in Hormozgan province in southern Iran.
